manifest.selection: No candidate selection or live promotion. Fixed variants, fixed minute offsets, chronological 60/20/20 report blocks.
manifest.limits: Retrospective data already inspected. Forecasts within markets are correlated. Proxy assumes opening basis persists, with trailing absolute residual stress; 95th percentile is empirical, not a guaranteed confidence bound. Historical settlement_ts is assumed public availability, not local historical receipt time. BRTI observations require both event and receipt timestamps. Proxy cannot observe the final settlement minute.
